balls.text: Sandeep goes wide of the crease and delivers a yorker. Jabbed in front of the bowler. They go for a single, Sandeep gets to the ball, has a over-arm throw at the stumps and misses. He could have had Rahul, who had given up. They get another off an overthrow. Sandeep has a wry smile on his face.. Bailey reciprocates with a rather sympathetic smile..
Rahul makes room outside leg, Sandeep follows him. Rahul opens his bat face and shovels it past the keeper, fine on the off side
yorker at the base of off, squirted in front of the covers
low full toss on off, hacked to deep midwicket as Rahul yanks his bottom hand off the bat and miscues it
full and outside off, flat-batted thump back to the bowler, who bends down in his follow through and takes some pace off it, deflecting it towards long-off. They steal one
he errs in length, does not get hold of the yorker. Slips in a yorker on middle and leg, clubbed over long-on
horrible full toss on the leg stump, mauled over deep midwicket
on a length and outside off, reverse-sweeps and misses

Manan Vohra nearly pulls off a gravity-defying catch by the deep square leg boundary, sticks his right hand out but the momentum carries him over the ropes. He is aware of it as he flicks it back into the playing area and saves a boundary. Sharp work. Too full on the pads, Rahul plays the pick-up shot, Vohra takes all the sheen off it

Karn makes room outside leg again, Anureet follows him with a full ball. Struck on the pads and they rush across for a leg bye. Anureet has a shy at the stumps but misses the direct it. Given as a run, though
low full toss on the pads, picked away to long leg
Karn steps away outside leg, Anureet follows him with a full toss. Whipped behind square
short, bumpy ball outside off at 137ks, Rahul pulls and can't connect
veering down leg, helped fine on the leg side. Sandeep has it covered in the deep
bounces rises over to Saha, Karn ducks out of trouble
change of pace outside off, chipped in front of long-off. Fooled by the slower one

Bailey under-arm flicks it onto the stumps. Bailey is confident. Ojha has to depart. Back of a length and on middle, pushed to short midwicket by Rahul, Bailey swoops down on the ball and hits the stumps. Ojha, who had taken a start, turns back and dives in vain. Too late for Ojha. The TV umpire rules it out. Twin strike for KXIP

soft dismissal. Soft end to a power-packed knock. Warner is on his haunches. He has to drag himself off the field. This was a low full toss on a fourth-stump line, chipped into the hands of midwicket off the toe end for a dolly. Gurkeerat has a smile on his face
yorker at the base of off, wrestled away to point with an angled bat
Warner steps away outside leg and pushes this low full toss to long-off
Warner makes room and puts off Anureet. The bowler follows Warner with a full toss. Sliced over the covers for another one bounce four. Inside-out

flat and powerful! Full toss tagged with width. Warner who was initially stepping away outside leg, reaches out and slaps it over the covers. It hits the ad boards on the flush. Oh no no, just bounces once before going over
down the track, manufactures a full toss and swipes to midwicket. Maxwell fumbles, no harm done
on a length and outside off, laced past the covers. Sweeper tidies up
shortish and hurries on off, Ojha manages an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to off and they sneak one
108.2ks, Change-up. Slowy short ball outside off, he reaches out and chops it towards point
138ks length and outside off, flat-batted down to long-off. They take two and beat the throw from the deep
back of a length down leg, missed glance. Wide
wide slower one outside off, Warner uses every inch of his reach and slaps it behind point. Axar dives, gets a hand to it and takes some pace off it

Top, low catch from Vohra as Mogan holes out. He dives to his left at deep square leg and throws the ball into the air in frustration. Length on middle, Morgan invests in a pick-up spot and connects well but Vohra intervenes
clipped off the pads to mid-on
slid through flat on leg as Warner makes room and chops it to off
short on the stumps, he hangs back and punches it past a diving bowler to long-on
pitched up and outside off, in the slot for Morgan. He plants his front foot forward and goes over the covers
encore! Tossed up on middle and leg, Morgan extends his arms and hoists it straight down the ground. Clean strike
on a length on middle, races down the track and thumps it for a flat six, beats long-off to his left
pushed through on middle and leg, played back to the bowler
straighter one, pushed back at the bowler
fuller and outside off, carved to sweeper cover. They press for two and get it

Anureet takes it by the edge of the boundary! Flatter and on a shortish length on off as Henriques advances down the track and swipes it. Anureet judges it well and completes a good overhead catch just before the deep midwicket boundary. He took a step or two back but held his balance, ensuring that the momentum did not take him beyond the ad boards.
banged in short and outside off, he goes for a pull and edges it onto the pad
fired on the leg stump, whisked to leg
bang! Take that. Tripe full toss, he camps back and hammers it away over deep midwicket. Into the big screen
full toss on middle and leg, hacked away to deep midwicket
flat and hard! A helmetless Warner loads it up to this full ball on middle. Blows it up and whacks it over deep midwicket
slider on off, dabbed in front of point with soft hands
swiped from outside off to long-on
length ball on the stumps, Warner backs away and smashes it over the covers. It goes all the way. What a way to get to a fifty
down the track, yorks himself and jabs it to the covers
fired outside off, keeps low. Henriques hacks and gets a thick edge that nutmegs Saha, sneaks through the legs
slid through outside off, down the track. He seeks to pull and ends up dragging it to long-on
full and outside off, Henriques nips down the track and lashes a drive to long-off
backs away, takes it from a middle-stump line and chops it towards sweeper
darted outside off from round the stumps, drilled to long-off
slid through on middle, backs away and punches it wide of point
Warner steps away outside leg, Sandeep chases him with a fullish ball, which is punched to long-off. Warner nearly hit Henriques..
low full toss again, he camps back and clips it through square leg
fuller and outside, drilled to the covers
right in the blockhole on off now, squeezed out to the left of Sandeep, towards mid-off
Sandeep hunts for a yorker, slips in another low full toss. Driven to long-off after backing away a touch
low full toss on the pads, he gets away. Henriques flicks it to deep square leg
short and outside off, Warner misses the pull for a change
too full and straight, clipped away to long leg
angled on a length and outside off, Henriques wants to drive, gets a thick outside edge to the third-man boundary. Gurkeerat runs across to his left, but is lazy to put in a dive
fuller length on off, Warner clears his front leg and scythes it over the covers
shortish and angled in, helped away in front of square leg
seeks a yorker at the base of leg, pushes it full, whipped away behind square leg after stepping away. Nifty wristwork
starts off a new spell badly. On a length and outside off, flashed to third man off an outer edge. The umpire calls out Hendricks for overstepping. Big no-ball
Warner pulls this half-tracker from outside off to long-on
pushed through on off, Henriques opens the face at the last instant and guides it to short third
fraction short on middle, he camps back and punches it back
pushed through on middle, short-arm pulled to long-on
straight roller on off, pushed back. Axar dives to his right and makes a good stop
back of a length and outside off, punched off the back foot to long-off
dropped short on middle, Warner profits. He shifts his balance onto the back foot and murders another pull. This one blazes away to the cow-corner fence
length, driven to long-on
down the track and pushed back to the bowler, who nearly collides with the non-striker. Gurkeerat stretches his right hand and makes a half-stop
picked away off the pads through square leg. There is protection in the deep
drives this full ball outside off to long-off
one-bounce four! Slower, length on middle, Henriques flits down the track and mows it over midwicket
Warner thrusts his bat in front of the pad and pushes it to the left of Maxi
fullish and outside off, driven to the covers
slid down leg, Warner misses the sweep. Wide
back of a length and outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
flat and quick, slashed through the covers
fuller and spins in, pushed to leg off the back foot

Maxi strikes first ball! The opening stand has been broken. He loops this up outside off and lures Dhawan out of the crease. This spins away a touch as well. He is beaten in flight, Saha makes no mistake now. Whips the bails off in a flash
I suspect that was the slower one, Dhawan comes down the track, swings and is beaten. So is Saha. SRH sneak a bye
full on the pads, whipped to mid-on
low full toss on off, jabbed to the covers off the toe-end of the bat
on a length and moves away past the outside edge. Warner goes for a big swish and does not connect
back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers. Maxi dives to his right, tries a direct hit and misses. Had ne nailed the stumps down, Dhawan was a goner
length on middle, Dhawan looks to drive and gets an inside edge to off
he bends low, goes for a paddle-sweep and finds short fine leg
slider on leg as Warner exposes all his stumps and chops it to the covers
down the track and punched to long-on.  The bowler had shortened his length
much quicker on the leg stump as Warner steps away, goes low for a sweep. Mistimes it as the ball goes only as far as in front of square leg
flatter on middle, Warner steps away, makes his own room and clunks a cut past the covers. Oh, boy I wish I had such fast hands
looped up slow on middle, flicked towards midwicket for one
back of a length and outside off, Dhawan aims to punch it through the covers. Manages an inside edge that sneaks away in front of square on the leg side
stray ball down leg, wide called
fuller and on middle, drilled ram-rod straight, so much so the drive hits the stumps at the non-strikers; and runs away towards mid-on. Hendricks did bent low but din't finger-tip it away
welcome to the zone of David Warner! Short of a length and outside off, Warner launches it over deep midwicket for another pulled six
much better, cramps Dhawan for room. Tucked in front of square on the leg side for one
slashed and he gets four. Back of a length and outside off, the thick outside edge skitters to the left of wide slip. Dhawan won't mind this one bit
on a fuller length and outside off, more pace on it. The ball comes onto the bat nicely, Dhawan plants his front foot forward and thrashes a drive past the covers
Dhawan skips down the track again. Sandeep is wary of it as he drags his length back. Punched through cover-point
on the pads again, Sandeep escapes punishment. Off the pads, Saha dives to his right and comes to the rescue of Sandeep
on a length and outside off, Dhawan nips down the track and flays this one to the right of the covers. Nails the gap. This is a breezy start from SRH
on the pads again, Dhawan succeeds in flicking it away. Does it behind square leg to the fine-leg boundary
veering onto the pads, Dhawan aims to flick it to leg. It goes wrong and he has to settle with a leading edge of sorts that pops in front of the covers
straighter in line, with a hint of away shape, pushed to the off side
14 off the over. Anureet has not recovered from the pasting last game. Width on offer outside off, Warner lashes it in the gap at the covers
what.a.shot! Anureet errs short and outside off, Warner fetches it from there, muscles a pull over midwicket. This one goes all the way.
back of a length and curling away outside off, pushed to the covers
on a length and close to off, too close to off for a cut. Chopped to the covers
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, not all that short. Warner rocks back and pulls it up and over midwicket, beats mid-on to his left as well. Good connection, good enough for a four
drifting onto the pads, tucked to the left of short midwicket for none
on a length and on middle, down the track and quietly pushes to mid-off
pitched up and teasing Dhawan around off, good away movement, he pushes and gets a thick outside edge past slip. Hendricks dives across and keeps it to two

back of a length and on middle, whipped away towards midwicket, where the fielder fumbles. Vohra, I guess, gives the chase from mid-on, slides and hauls the ball in before the boundary. The result is three
Warner gets right behind this length ball on middle, blocks it solidly to the covers
on a good length accompanied by some away swing outside off. 'Wait on' cries Warner as he dabs it straight to short cover
nice and full on middle, Warner presses forward and gently blocks it back to the bowler
Miller smashes a six off the last ball but SRH win by 5 runs. Low full toss outside off, Miller goes down on one knee and swipes it over long-on
the crowd roars, Warner applauds. Low full toss on leg, dragged to cow corner
to the right of short third man. Ishant does not nail the yorker, full toss outside off. Miller throws his bat at it, gets a thick outside edge wide of the fielder in the ring
yorker, right in the blockhole, bunted to long-off. Miller refuses the single
Miller is on fire! This was bad ball, though. Full toss outside off, slapped dismissively over the covers for back-to-back sixes
feeds Miller with length on leg stump, he clears his front leg and slugs it over cow corner

Naman Ojha pouches it. Bhuvi strikes with his last ball. Axar shuffles across off, Bhuvi follows him with a full ball, he seeks to paddle it away but does not get hold of it. Toe ends it to Ojha, who moves back and steadies under it
another low full toss, clubbed to deep midwicket. Dhawan attacks the ball and keeps it to a single. Axar has to retreat
low full toss on middle, powered to cow corner between Dhawan and Miller. The latter wants two, Axar puts in a desperate dive and makes it
too full and outside off, Miller sizes it up, bends his knees and slices it over the long-off. Clears the fielder
low full toss on the stumps, dragged to Dhawan again at deep midwicket. No mix-ups here
low full toss on the leg stump, whipped away to Dhawan at deep midwicket. Miller wants two, but is sent back. He turns back, dives and beats the throw from the deep
banged in short and hurries on, Miller loads up for a pull and gets an edge behind square leg
full toss on the leg stump, Miller sinks to one knee and pastes it over deep midwicket
length and just passes the leg stump, slog and a miss

slower short ball on middle, Miller steps away, makes room. Waits for it, adjusts and slams it over cover-point. Hits the ad cushions on the flush. Miller gets a to fifty with a six. Some consolation for KXIP
swiped to long-on with plenty of bottom hand
fuller and on middle, punched on the up over Miller for a four
yorker just outside off, Miller sinks to one knee for a slog, the ball slides under the bat
Bhuvi misses the yorker, pushes it too full. Miller gets under it and launches it straight down the ground
Miller moves around in the crease, Bhuvi delivers a very full ball outside leg, whipped to deep midwicket for another two
shortish and hurries on middle, he goes for the pull and splices it in the air into no-man's land over midwicket
yorker, right in the blockhole. Skewed behind square leg off an inner edge. They take on Ishant's arm and take two
low full toss on off, dragged to long-on
back of a length and on the hips, eased to long leg
full and on middle, slower in pace, Axar check his loft and chips it over the bowler's head, one-bounce four
leg-side wide
yorker on the leg stump, strikes Miller on the back pad. Miller cleared his front leg but missed the swipe. This was sliding down leg
just misses the leg stump. Miller moves in the crease and shuffles across off. Off-cutter, almost grazes leg as Miller can't put bat on ball
over the left of short fine leg. Short and leg-stumpish, swivels on the back foot and helps it over the fielder with a controlled pull
fuller and on middle and leg, tucked away backward of square on the leg side
slower ball at 110ks, check-pushed to long-off
on a length and outside off, crashed to long-off
length ball outside off, wild swipe and miss after stepping out
sprays this full one outside off, Miller can't reach out and connect. Wide
fuller in length, down the track and slashed to third man off a thick outer edge. Kings XI reach three figures
bumper from Henriques, flies to the keeper as Axar half-sways and gets his noggin out of the way
on good length and outside off, pokes and misses

The slide continues for Kings XI.. On a length and outside off, Gurkeerat wants to turn this over the leg side, gets a leading edge and spoons a simple catch to Eoin Morgan at backward point. Third for Henriques. His night is getting better and better
leg-break outside off with some extra bounce. Dabbed awkwardly to the right of the keeper
flat on the pads, slog-swept hard to Warner at deep square leg
It was in Miller's arc and its out of the park. Fullish and on off, down on one knee and slog-swept powerfully over deep midwicket
pitched up and on a fourth-stump line, Gurkeerat flits down the track and drives it to long-off
picked away off the pads behind square on the leg side
fuller length on middle and leg, wrong'un. Miller skips out and swings it over long-on.
back of a length and outside off, cudgelled to sweeper cover
bumpy short ball, gets very big on Gurkeerat, who hops up and possibly gloves it behind square on the off side
pitched up and outside off, kept out to leg off an inner edge

Warner reverse-cups his hands around it. Bailey gone now. This was a slower, short ball outside off. Offcutter with extra bounce. Bailey is undone by the change-up. He wanted to go hard on it but ends up chipping it to Warner at cover
takes this short ball from outside off and flat-bats it to long-on, on the bounce
back of a length and on middle, Bailey advances and tucks it to leg off the inner part of the bat
flat and quick, almost shaves the leg stump. Miller does not connect with the pull, on another day this would have clipped the leg stump. Karn can't believe it
fuller and on middle and leg, swept behind square leg
strikes Miller on the back pad as he sinks to one knee and does not meet with the sweep. Going down leg
pushed through on the pads, clipped to deep square leg
flicked in front of square
Bailey comes down the track and takes it on the pad. Tossed up on the stumps, beaten in flight
on a back of a length and on off, whipped to Dhawan at midwicket for one
pitched up and shapes away past the hanging bat of Bailey
short and climbs outside off, Miller rises with it and punches it up and over cover-point
fractionally short and outside off, Bailey camps back and mis-hits a pull over square leg
back of a length on off, blocked back to the bowler
back of a length and outside off, shovelled past midwicket
shortish and rises on off, guided to deep third man
full and outside off, dragged to mid-on off the inner part of the bat
pitched up and outside off, he rocks forward and laces it to the covers
picked away to deep midwicket
on a length and comes in, pushed to mid-on
Miller wants to flick, gets a leading edge that loops over the covers

Rahul pulls off a sharp, low catch, one-hander! Saha has to depart. Fullish and outside off, Saha drives it in the air. Rahul runs in from mid-off, dives forward and plucks it out with his right hand. I thought it would have popped out, but he managed to hang on to it.. Rahul went with both hands, it got stuck in the right hand
short and just a shade outside off, Saha does not connect with a pull
full and outside off, cracked to sweeper cover
punched to the covers
slower ball on off at 110ks, down the track, Saha adjusts and drags it to deep midwicket
shortish on leg, he does not connect with the pull. Off the shoulder in front of square leg. He may have gotten an edge on that, given as a run
back of a length swerves in, he pushes from the crease and keeps it out off an inside edge
slash and a miss to a back of a length ball outside off. Wide called, past the tram line
on a fuller length and outside off, he chips a drive past the covers
back of a length, defended

Boult gets rid of Maxi... The home crowd loving this. This was on a back of a length and moving across off with some extra lift, Maxi has a lazy waft and nicks it off to the keeper off an outer edge. Maxi had yanked his bottom hand off the bat while playing at it. Crucial strike. Maxi fails against SRH for the first time
back of a length and outside off, flat-batted thump past the covers. Sweeper runs to his left, dives and is beaten. Morgan, the fielder there
slower ball on off at 126ks, pushed to long-off
crunched! Maxi connects this and connects well. Runs down the track and lofts this full ball outside off over long-off with authority
tossed up nicely and just outside off, he loads up for a signature reverse-swat and fails to connect
flat and quick, Maxi goes on the back foot and chops it to the covers
flighted and outside off, sticks in the pitch. Check-driven to long-off
looped up and spins away, dabbed in front of cover-point

holed out to long-on! Two wickets in three balls for Bipul. Flighted and full outside off, he miscues the lofted strike and finds Bhuvi, who helps himself to a overhead catch. Vohra's bright innings has been cut short
Vohra makes room outside leg, Ishant follows him with a 125ks ball, patted towards mid-off
back of a length and on middle, guided to the left of short fine leg
dug in short and rises on middle, Saha gets on top of the bounce and quells it to the covers
on a fuller length and outside off, pressed to the covers for a quick single. The fielder had one stump to aim at, hits it but Saha is in
Ishant shortens his length and outside off, carved to third man
pitched up and outside off, Vohra is crease-bound as he drives, thick outside edge to third man
slower through the air and outside off, dabbed to point with an open face

Bipul takes out Vijay in his first over. Smart, low catch from Dhawan. Nicely tossed up and outside off, this one also holds up in the pitch. Vijay looks to drive but is timing is foiled as he feebly chips it to cover, where Dhawan dives forward and snaffles it. Dhawan enjoyed that catch.. He slaps his thigh and twirls his mustache..
leading edge - pops in between covers and the bowler. This one held up in the pitch
Vohra wants to hammer this away, gets an inside edge onto the pad
b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l. Looped up and outside off, Vohra backs away and lofts it inside out over the covers with poise; one-bounce four
full and outside off, he reaches for a booming drive through the covers. Fails to connect
131.9ks, down the track, wild swing and a miss
banged in short and outside off, Ishant enlists his height to generate good extra bounce. Vijay goes hard on the pull and top-edges it over Naman Ojha
carved towards deep third man from outside off via a thick edge
comes in on the pads with the angle, Vohra twirls his wrists and picks it up over and wide of short fine leg for a flat six
pitched up and on off, defended off the back foot
short and following the batsman, who was making room outside leg. Misses his shot and is struck on the elbow
top edge flies to the right of Naman Ohja. Short again, this is outside off. Vijay is in no position for the pull. Skews it away to the third-man boundary
bouncer climbs over a leg-stump line. Half-ducked by Vijay
fraction short and outside off as Vijay skips down the track and flat-bats it to the covers. Slapped straight to the fielder
back of a length and zips away outside off with some extra lift, Vijay does not move his feet. Chases it and the ball passes the outside edge
on a length and outside off, steered past a diving backward point to third man
back of a length and swerves in, Vohra twirls his wrists and connects with the flick. Directs it backward of square on the leg side
on the pads again, Vijay helps it away fine on the leg side. Easy pickings. Vohra had missed out but Vijay cashed in
swinging in on the pads, they sneak in a leg bye. Missed glance
full and just a shade outside off, he looks to drive with his feet in cement, gets an inner edge that dribbles past the stumps
pitched up and on a fourth-stump line, he shuffles across and works it to midwicket
length comes in on middle, dragged between midwicket and mid-on. Not middled, but no problem
Hello Boult, says Vijay. On a length and swings in on the leg stump, Vijay picks it up and deposits it over backward square leg
Vijay opens the face of his bat on impact with this shortish ball outside off and glides it to deep third man
Bhuvi skims past the outside edge. On a length and swings away outside off with some extra bounce. Wafts and misses
on a length and outside off, guided to point again
back of a length and swerving away outside off, Vijay pushes to point with an angled bat
full and outside off, pressed to point
on a good length and swings in on off, Vijay gets right behind the line and blocks it stoutly
